narrative.details: Welcome back champion. Our collection grows, but even now we have a need for additional purple lotus. If it is still within your power to gather more of the herb, I entreat you to do so and return them to me here.
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 purple lotus to Master Nightsong at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
